QuestInfo.name: Don Hwang's Request
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #p406# at #m10003000# is the one to talk to if I'm looking for work...
QuestInfo.1: I paid #p406# a commission of 1,000 mesos in exchange for her bringing me various jobs and requests from the citizens of #m10003000#. The first request is from #p409#, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials for crafting new armor. I need to defeat #r20 #o9#s#k and #r20 #o10#s#k, and collect #b10 #t4000009#s#k and #b10 #t4000010#s#k. It shouldn't be too hard, since #o9#s and #o10#s are easy to find near #m10003000#.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered what #p409# asked for and got a bunch of #t2010005#s in return. I wonder what kind of armor #p409# will make. Nella said there are many more requests I can fulfill. I should visit #p406# every once in a while.

0.0: Whoa, I haven't seen you before! I'm guessing you're not from here. My name's #b#p406##k, and I know everything that goes on around town. That's right, I'm always the first with any juicy pieces of news!
0.1: For #b1,000 Mesos#k, I can gather some intel and hook you up with work. You game? Think of me as your agent! I get a cut, but you get a gig.

yes.0: Awesome! Like I promised, you give me 1,000 Mesos, I give you the hook-ups. I'm so efficient, I have your first job right here. #b#p409##k from the armor store has been collecting rare items for a new piece of armor he's trying to create.
yes.1: It shouldn't be too hard for you to defeat #b20 #o9#s#k and #b20 #o10#s#k, and get me #b10 #t4000009#s#k and #b10 #t4000010#s#k, right? Once you get me the goods, I'll slide you your reward. Now get to work!

no.0: Hey, it's your call. You change your mind, you give me a call.

1.0: Got the goods? Excellent! Here's your reward. #b#p409##k has provided a bunch of #b#t2010005#s#k as payment. Use them well!

yes.0: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p409##k requested. You need to defeat #b20 #o9#s#k and #b20 #o10#s#k and gather #b10 #t4000009#s#k and #b10 #t4000010#s#k to help with the new piece of armor. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
